description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offers" name="Offers" messageRef="Msg_Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSeveral" name="Order parts" messageRef="Msg_Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSingleShop" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSeveralShops" name="Order cheapest parts from several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Orders placed"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatchArrives" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically +/- 2 days earlier or later.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Build loop merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build with parts in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildFinished" name="Building finished?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck" name="Stock level of each part"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteComplaintMail" name="Write mail to friends complaining about web shops"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Built" name="Building finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start_Query" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProjectNeedsParts" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Offers_Evaluate" sourceRef="Event_OffersReceived" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Evaluate_List" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOffers" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_List_Split" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Single_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough" targetRef="Task_OrderSingleShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Single_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderSingle_Merge" sourceRef="Task_OrderSingleShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderSeveral_Merge" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderMerge_Batch" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Event_FirstBatchArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Batch_Receive" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatchArrives" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Receive_Start" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BuildMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Build_Finished" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_BuildFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotFinished_Stock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFinished" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Finished_End" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFinished" targetRef="EndEvent_Built"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Stock_OK" name="All parts at 5 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Stock_Cheapest" name="Below 5 but not below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Stock_Fastest" name="Below 3 but not zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Stock_Zero" name="Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Cheapest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Fastest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Mail_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
